thesis: CDNA is a beta-2.5 stock that has already run +71% in 63 days and gapped 22% on earnings, and it is now rolling over from the 90.87 high (5-day -8.7%) in a confirmed risk-off tape where QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages. Valuation is rich (forward PE 51, EV/EBITDA 157) and the earnings quality is poor: operating margin is 1.6% and the 110.6M quarter looks non-recurring, so the headline earnings growth is not a clean signal. The proposed stop (75.3) is only about 0.7 ATR from entry on a stock with 6.8% daily ATR, so normal noise is likely to stop it out, and the 3.0 R/R is a paper number. The news and SEC-filing feeds are empty, so a post-rally S-3/424B5 raise cannot be ruled out and nobody can see what drove the gap. Waiting costs little: a re-test of the 72 to 69 area would give a better entry.
